wifiFirmware.notes: The Pi 3B's WiFi/BT combo chip is a BCM43438 (brcmfmac chip ID 43430), and in RPi-Distro/firmware-nonfree the brcmfmac driver's board+chip lookup for 'raspberrypi,3-model-b' resolves via git symlinks to the SAME underlying blob set the original Pi Zero W uses ('raspberrypi,model-zero-w', see build/boards/pi-zero-w/manifest.json): brcmfmac43430-sdio.raspberrypi,3-model-b.{bin,clm_blob} -> ../cypress/cyfmac43430-sdio.{bin,clm_blob} (Cypress-branded blobs in the sibling 'cypress/' upstream directory) and brcmfmac43430-sdio.raspberrypi,3-model-b.txt -> brcmfmac43430-sdio.txt (a real file in 'brcm/'). No 43430b0 alias exists for 'raspberrypi,3-model-b' at this commit (verified against the full brcm/ directory listing on 2026-07-26: 43430b0 aliases exist only for model-zero-2-w), so exactly these three aliases are needed. Since gosd's initramfs can't carry symlinks (per gosd-eu2x), the board profile materializes all three alias dest names as literal duplicate copies of their 'of' file's bytes, flattened into the SAME destDir ('brcm/') as the base files. All six sha256s in this manifest were re-verified by independent download on 2026-07-26 (bean gosd-ypg1) and are byte-identical to the pi-zero-w/pi-zero-2w manifests' pins where shared.
